title: Choose the app shell layout
question: Same FocusFlow world (navy shell, blue actions, lighter work areas). Pick how the signed-in app is organised, or re-roll.

options.label: Project rail
options.thesis: Every project is one click away on a slim navy rail; Today is the first stop on it.
options.viewport: 72px navy rail of project tiles, a navy context panel for the selected project, and a light agenda canvas with Today's tasks grouped by due time.
options.risk: Project tiles need short names or initials; a 7th+ project scrolls the rail.

raised.raise: The selected project's own colour owns its rail tile and panel header at full strength, not just a dot.
Agenda rows sit on a strict time column so the next due task reads like the next departure.

options.label: Docked agenda
options.thesis: Your personal agenda stays docked beside whichever project board you open.
options.viewport: Navy top bar with project tabs; a navy agenda dock on the left (overdue, today, next 7 days) and the light project board filling the rest.
options.risk: Less board width on laptops; the dock must collapse cleanly.

options.label: Agenda sidebar
options.thesis: A classic navy sidebar with Today, Projects and Calendar, opening on a light agenda page.
options.viewport: 240px navy sidebar listing views and projects; light main page led by a week strip and Today's task list with a mini calendar on the right.
options.risk: The most familiar layout of the three; distinctiveness rests on detail.

options.label: Departures agenda
options.thesis: Today's work as a departures board: rows ranked by due time, live updates flip in place.
options.viewport: Navy top bar; a full-width board of today's tasks in fixed columns (due, task, project, column, status), overdue rows in amber.
options.case: Students read departure boards daily and 'what's due next' maps cleanly; loses on navigation, which it leaves to a plain top bar.
options.risk: Can read as a novelty if the flip animation shows up anywhere but real live changes.

options.label: Tabbed manual
options.thesis: Projects as a stepped, colour-coded tab rail down the page edge.
options.viewport: Full-strength section colour behind the current project with a tab rail on the right edge.
options.case: Its full-strength section hues would replace the navy identity.
options.kept: Project colour owns the selected state at full strength.

options.label: Metro tiles
options.thesis: Projects as flat live tiles on a panorama.
options.viewport: Panorama of project tiles with cropped headlines.
options.case: Panorama navigation fights frequent project switching and the drag-and-drop board.

options.label: Ticket wallet
options.thesis: Tasks as tear-off coupons in a wallet.
options.viewport: A stack of task coupons, used ones stamped.
options.case: Coupons are a one-way journey; tasks move between columns.
options.kept: Done tasks stay visible, marked rather than vanishing.

options.label: Dance score
options.thesis: Time running upward on a centre staff.
options.viewport: Vertical staff with task blocks sized by duration.
options.case: Tasks have due dates, not durations; nobody here reads notation.

options.label: Guide map
options.thesis: Projects as colour lobes on a map.
options.case: Replaces the navy world and standard controls.
